name: access-review
description: Reviews who has prod or admin access against your org roster. Paste an access export from your identity provider (CSV/TSV: user, email, system, role, last sign-in, status) and your roster (email, name, title, manager, status), and optionally name your code-host organization to check its members, owners, outside collaborators and repo admins. It flags terminated people who still have access, accounts not on the roster, dormant accounts, privileged roles without a matching job title, too many owners and outside collaborators with admin, each with its evidence and rule, and drafts removal requests as text. Defaults: dormant after 90 days, at most 3 owners, admin titles engineering/SRE/DevOps/platform/security/infrastructure/IT; change them in one line. It never removes, suspends or changes any access and never sends the requests.

skills.name: Access review
skills.description: Compares a pasted access export and roster (plus, optionally, your code-host organization) and lists what needs a decision: terminated with access, not on roster, dormant, privileged without a role need, excess owners, outside collaborator admins. Removal requests are drafted as text, never sent.
examples: Review prod access against this roster (paste `access:` and `roster:` blocks)
Who still has access to our code-host org acme but left the company?
Draft removal requests for terminated people
